[CGMZ] Splash Screen
By: Casper Gaming
Last Update: March 15, 2026
Latest Version: 1.4.0
​
Creates a splash screen before the title screen. It can handle multiple splashes, and splashes can be skipped with input.
Add as many splash images as you want
Skip splashes with input
Control how long each splash image displays
Spoiler:
Screenshots
Full screen splash image
Smaller images will be centered
Import into plugin manager and enable the plugin. Some customization options available. Further instructions in plugin.
Online documentation can be found on my
website
.
User documentation can be found on the
Casper Gaming Wiki
.

posts.author: CasperGaming
CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all, this plugin received a minor update today to version 1.2.1!
This update adds the option to skip the splash screen scene in playtests. With this option enabled, the splash screens will still display in a deployed game. This should help speed up your playtesting by not needing to sit through the splash screens every time.
This update also changed the SE and BGM parameters for splashes to allow you to change their pitch, pan, and volume. You will need to reset your SE and BGM parameters for each splash as a result.
This update added Spanish language help documentation. This plugin will now warn instead of crash when it encounters invalid JSON in a plugin parameter. Invalid JSON occurs when a plugin parameter is set up incorrectly. These warnings are still important to fix.
Version 1.2.1
Added option to skip splash screen scene in playtests
Added volume, pan, pitch options to se/bgm settings
Added Spanish language help documentation
Warn instead of crash when parameters set up incorrectly

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all, today this plugin was updated to version 1.2.2!
This version is a small update to add a new parameter for your splashes: unskippable. When this is true, the player will not be able to skip a splash with input. When this is false, the player will be able to skip a splash by pressing the ok input (current behavior for all splashes).
Version 1.2.2
Added option to make a splash unskippable

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all, today this plugin was updated to version 1.3.0!
This version is a re-write of this plugin to use the new default splash screen scene instead of the custom one from before RPG Maker had splash screens by default.
This update also added video splashes, so you can now show a video during your splash screen sequence. The player can still skip these splashes with input unless the unskippable flag is enabled. See below gif for how it can look:
The parameters for display time and fade in/out have been moved to the splash screen setup instead of being global for all splashes. I thought with videos, you may want different length splash screens, so now you can do that.
Version 1.3.0
Added video splash
Display time and fade speed parameters now per-splash

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all, today this plugin was updated to version 1.3.1!
With the change in 1.3.0 to use the default splash screen, some sprite behavior changed such as the automatic scaling and centering of the splash sprites. This is due to the new default code, but I have heard some feedback asking for the old way which did not have scaling for sprites. I decided to add both an option to center and an option to scale the sprite for each splash as a result, so you should once again be able to have your sprites not scaled or centered.
Version 1.3.1
Added option to scale sprite
Added option to center sprite

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all, today this plugin was updated to version 1.4.0!
This version adds a [CGMZ] Rumble integration so you can now rumble the player's controller during your splash screens. This can work with a delay, in case you also want to time it with a delayed sound effect.
Version 1.4.0
Added [CGMZ] Rumble integration
